notes.title: Patch notes 1.3.3
notes.content: [p]A small patch with some bug fixes and some visual updates[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed some water behaving incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Water splash effect was rotated the wrong way, this has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly adjusted the ghost movement visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the goal visuals, the goal should be more clear and easier to see.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Water splash effect was rotated the wrong way, this has been fixed.

tags.balance_change: Slightly adjusted the ghost movement visuals.

tags.feature: Updated the goal visuals, the goal should be more clear and easier to see.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.3.2
notes.content: [list][*][p]Ghosts are now enabled by default, you can still toggle them off in the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where long names from the leaderboard would clip into the ghost body.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Ghosts are now enabled by default, you can still toggle them off in the pause menu.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where long names from the leaderboard would clip into the ghost body.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.3.1
notes.content: [p]Ghost files were being uploaded as private which prevented players from downloading them.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Newly created ghost files are now uploaded as public(Previously private).[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Ghost files were being uploaded as private which prevented players from downloading them.

tags.feature: Newly created ghost files are now uploaded as public(Previously private).

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added controller support.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Let us know if there are any issues with it, either in-game or the UI.[/p]

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1.0 - Added widescreen support
notes.content: [p]We have now worked on adding support for widescreen and ultra widescreen. We don't have a widescreen to test on, so if there are any issues arising regarding widescreen, please let us know.[/p][list][*][p]Added widescreen support (21:9 and 32:9).[/p][/*][/list]
